engineeringSkip.reason: Nuclear pasta exists only inside neutron-star crusts under extreme gravitational pressure; a room-temperature material of that density cannot be bound by any known physics, so this is speculation rather than an engineering pathway.

factCheck.reason: Neutron-star matter exists only because a star's enormous gravity crushes it together, and no laboratory process can hold that density in a room-temperature material, so 'nuclear pasta' cannot be frozen into a stable composite.
